name: Allendorf (Eder, Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:4:1, charged in the upper half of the white stripe with the municipal arms of Allendorf (Eder) (a white crescent and star on blue).
history: On 11 April 1967 the Hessian Minister of the Interior approved the flag, described as blue-white-blue (1:4:1) striped with the municipal arms in the upper half of the white middle stripe.

features.role: Allendorf (Eder) arms — crescent and star on blue
